title: Engineering Design Process Overview
centralClaim: The engineering design process is a structured approach to problem solving, involving iterative stages that vary by model.
whyItMatters: Provides a foundational understanding of how engineered systems are developed and refined.

contributors.name: Unknown Author(s)
contributors.reason: Authoring the 'Engineering Design Process' essay which outlines the process.

objections: Models can be overly rigid and fail to account for emergent properties.
The iterative nature can lead to scope creep and increased costs.
Stages are often simplified, obscuring the complexity of real-world design challenges.
